facts.text: Appeal item: STC 45 and IIC 45 requirements for a deck above an accessory dwelling unit's living space; the applicant requests use of Assembly B from an attached report (ESR-2994) with a 60-mil TPO membrane and polyester felt underlayment in place of cushion vinyl.

The applicant compares listed minimums and product data: the Assembly B minimum for cushion vinyl is 4.8 oz/sf and 3.1 mm thick; the TPO membrane is listed as 5.152 oz/sf and 1.52 mm thick; the poly felt underlayment is 0.44 oz/sf.
Decision: alternate one-hour roof/ceiling detail for the exterior deck above the ADU is granted as proposed.
